name: Log-out and Log-backIn
instruction: Navigate to the FYI app. Tap the profile icon in the bottom navbar, then tap Settings. Swipe down and tap Logout. Tap "Join the movement". Tap the +971 country code and search for United States. Enter the mobile number 2345678916 and tap the blue arrow. On the "Confirm your phone number" screen, enter 123456 — type it slowly. Wait for the "Tell us about yourself" screen, tap it, then tap the blue arrowmark once the profile picture is visible. Click on "I understand if i lost my encryption...." and click on next  a tutorial is gonna appear with just click on the middle 2 times
success:
1. User logs out from the FYI app 
2. User logs back into the FYI App and can see the chat screen and the navbar with AI, Chat, Projects and Profile
